exposure: mild-range blood pressures on day of discharge
outcome: attendance of postpartum blood pressure evaluation
finding: Clinical factors such as nulliparity, severe HDP, and cesarean birth were associated with higher rates of postpartum blood pressure evaluation attendance, whereas sociodemographic factors such as maternal non-Hispanic black race and ethnicity and public insurance were associated with lower odds.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was associated with higher rates of postpartum blood pressure evaluation attendance.
